visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of landscape photos with captions that open an image lightbox
notes: Cream background; small gold uppercase eyebrow and large uppercase heading, centred; 3-up landscape photos with uppercase captions; each opens a lightbox (image only, despite the component name).

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: cell 1 = image (opens lightbox), cell 2 = caption paragraph
blockContent: 3 gallery items, each landscape photo + uppercase caption, opening an image lightbox

reuseGuidance: Use for images that enlarge in a lightbox. Use cards-video for video posters, cards for linked cards.
